voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last thousand candles of OHLCV data for the strategy to read.
Next we add a MACD with fast 12, slow 26 and signal 9 to measure momentum.
Then we create a bullish trigger that fires when the MACD line crosses above its signal line.
We also add a bearish trigger that fires when the MACD line crosses below the signal line.
We plot the MACD line in a soft gray so its movement is visible on the chart.
Next we draw the signal line in bright orange to contrast with the MACD.
Finally we plot the histogram in deep blue to show the divergence between them.
We then run the strategy through the backtest engine to generate trades and performance stats.
Lastly we overlay the trade markers so you can see entries, exits and profit zones on the chart.

outro.voiceover: You now see the MACD, signal line and histogram plotted with bullish and bearish triggers highlighted, ready to backtest.
